The '''Trellen Trade Route''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace trade route]] that was commonly used to bypass the [[Marasa Nebula/Legends|Marasa Nebula]].

After subjugating the [[Marasan]] civilization which lived within the Marasa Nebula, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] forced them to help Imperial [[Starship/Legends|starships]] navigate through the nebula. With the use of Marasan navigators, [[anchorpoint]]s, and [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]], Imperial ships could use the nebula as a shortcut while traveling the Trellen route.
